held.title: `getMoneyAccountTransactionType` may get an undefined confirmation or a signature request.
held.body: This hook runs for every confirmation, including signature requests. The code just above reads `(currentConfirmation as TransactionMeta)?.txParams` with optional chaining, which suggests `currentConfirmation` can be undefined. The new call casts it to `TransactionMeta` and passes it to `getMoneyAccountTransactionType` with no guard. If that helper reads `.type` or `.nestedTransactions` without optional chaining, the alert hook throws while the confirmation is loading. I can't see the helper's code. Guard the call, for example `currentConfirmation ? getMoneyAccountTransactionType(currentConfirmation as TransactionMeta) : undefined`, or confirm the helper accepts undefined.
